basis: Prospective primary abundance gate fails; independent reproduction confirms primary tissue values, arrays and initial culture normalization. Bounded GSE4303 and USZ23 follow-up does not rescue the originally proposed broadly reproducible appreciable expression phenotype.
value_assessment: This rejects a hypothesis created for this campaign, not an important established claim about EMC. Therefore a technically valid low-expression result is not by itself a worthwhile negative paper.
preserved_adverse_and_positive_evidence: Two high-expression, source-labelled fusion-positive EMC specimens are retained; no posthoc subtype or replacement diagnosis. GSE4303 ratios to reference cannot establish absolute absence. USZ23 zeros apply to mapped current transcripts, with original source-index completeness limitation explicit.
reopening_condition: Specific independent authenticated evidence resolving the low/heterogeneous tissue signal and establishing a consequential new EMC phenotype. Examples include tumor-cell DLK1 protein/localization in a reproducible subgroup, or an independently supported molecular/functional subgroup with a useful new implication; this is not a blanket wet-lab requirement. More favorable bulk examples alone do not resolve the present value problem. No current public evidence demonstrates a reopening condition.
remaining_work: Freeze and integrate owner packet; retain all unresolved accessible or unavailable source coverage. No drafting/polishing/release work.
small_RNA_lane: Separate original question remains open while a newly identified, not yet primary-authenticated 2013 16-profile abstract lead is traced. No mechanistic inference from coexistence of separate studies.
